IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Senators Kohl-Welles, Kline, Fairley and Carrell

Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing the crime of "slander of a woman."

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the crime of slander of a woman; andrepealing RCW 9.58.110 and 9.58.120.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 9.58.110 (Slander of woman) and 1909 c 249 s 181; and RCW 9.58.120 (Testimony necessary to convict) and 1927 c 90 s1 & 1909 c 249 s 182.
